en.bdb: Gurmukh, association with the saints  count of six),  -

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਤਰਸਣਿ ਘਣੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chhia dharasan tarasan ghane gurmukh satigur dharasan paiaa|

en.bdb: Followers of six (Indian. philosophies) crave intensely but only gurmukh gets the glimpse of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chhia saasatr samajhaavanee gurmukh gur upadhes dhiRaiaa|

en.bdb: The six Shastras make one understand in a round about manner but gurmukhs make the teachings of the Guru firmly lodged in the heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: raag naadh visamaadh vich gurmat satigur sabadh sunaiaa|

en.bdb: All the musical measures and melodies are wonder-struck to feel that

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਇਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rutee kar varatamaan sooraj ik chalat varataiaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is such as the one sun remains stabilized in all the six seasons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰਸ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਚਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chhia ras saau na painee gurmukh sukh fal piram chakhaiaa|

en.bdb: Such a pleasure-fruit has been attained by Gurmukhs, the taste of which could not be known by six pleasures.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਣੇ ਚਕ੍ਰਵਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jatee satee chir jeevane chakravarat hoi mohe maiaa|

en.bdb: Anchorites, followers of truth, long lived ones and universally acclaimed ones are all engrossed in delusions.
Only joining the holy congregation, one could be absorbed in one's innate nature.
